units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 3:11">Targ. Job III, 11</cite> <he>אֵינִיק</he> (Ms. <he>אִינַק</he>; ed. Lag. <cite ref="J00446"><he>אוֹנִיק</he></cite>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 1:3:8">Y. Ned. I, 37ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 56:9">Gen. R. s. 56</cite> <he>אימר דלא י׳ וכ׳</he> the lamb that never sucked (the ram offered in Isaac’s place).
<cite ref="Berakhot 40b:15">Ber. 40ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>מירבא … מֵינַק לא יַנְקֵי וכ׳</he> they grow out of the ground, but draw no nurture from it.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 71b:3">B. Bath. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>מדנפשיה קא ינקי</he> they draw from the ground which belongs to himself.

<cite ref="Beitzah 37b:10">Bets. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>י׳ תחומין מהדדי</he> the parts of an animal whose partners are bound by opposite Sabbath limits draw substances one from the other (v. Y. Erub. III, 21ᵃ quoted in <cite ref="J00445">preced.</cite>); a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 32:13">Targ. Y. Deut. XXXII, 13</cite>; a. fr.—
Gen. R. s. 98, end דהכן אוֹנִיקוּ which nursed such a child; Y. Kil. I, 27ᵇ top אַיְינֵק; Gen. R. s. 5 end מניק (corr. acc.), v. בִּיזָּא III; a. fr.—מֵינִיקְתָּא nurse.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 2:7">Targ. Ex. II, 7</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="M01228"><he>מֵינִיקָתָא</he></cite>, v. infra.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 15:2">Targ. Y. II, Ex. XV, 2</cite> (Y. I <he>מוֹנִיק</he>).

XL, 11</cite> <cite ref="M01228"><he>מֵינִיקָתָא</he></cite>) animals giving suck (h. text <he>עלות</he>).—Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 27 <he>יַנְּקִין</he>, v. <cite ref="J00433"><he>יַנּוֹקָא</he></cite>
